visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with a polished makeup look and hair pulled back into a bun faces the camera. She points at her eye with her index finger, emphasizing her long, curled eyelashes. The setting is a brightly lit indoor dressing room with a large white shelving unit in the background, densely packed with various cosmetics, perfumes, and skincare products. She wears a black t-shirt with a white graphic print. (2) The scene transitions as the woman claps her hands together enthusiastically. Overlays of social media message screenshots appear on the left, showing user inquiries about her eyelashes. The lighting remains bright and even, highlighting her expressive facial features as she talks directly to the viewer. (3) The woman holds up a clear plastic product package for '1028' brand glue-free false eyelashes. She points at the individual lash clusters inside the tray. The camera captures her hands clearly, showing her neat nails. She continues to explain the product features while the makeup-filled background remains visible. (4) A close-up shot follows, focusing on her eye and the use of a white heated eyelash curler. She demonstrates curling her natural lashes. Then, using a pair of curved metal tweezers, she carefully picks up a lash cluster from the tray and applies it to her lash line. (5) A split-screen or side-by-side comparison appears with text labels 'Before' and 'After'. The 'After' side shows significantly more defined and elongated lashes. She points to both eyes to show the difference. (6) The woman concludes the video by gesturing with her hands and holding the product again. She smiles and delivers her final remarks, standing in the same indoor setting with the cosmetic shelf behind her.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 最近迷上 免膠假睫毛. (2) [Subtitle]: 上次我在限動發完 之後就很多人敲碗教學. (3) [Subtitle]: 今天就來教大家 怎麼使用吧!. (4) [Subtitle]: 我今天用的是1028新出的 天生纖長款. (5) [Subtitle]: 它是一眼分成三段 上面有自帶果膠. (6) [Subtitle]: 一般假睫毛是由上往下貼居多 但這種免膠假睫毛它的膠是上在上層. (7) [Subtitle]: 所以我們是由內眼瞼往上貼. (8) [Subtitle]: 先用燙睫毛器把睫毛燙翹. (9) [Subtitle]: 我會選這種有角度的睫毛輔助夾. (10) [Variety]: *重點筆記. [Subtitle]: 稍微凹一下睫毛讓它有個弧度. (11) [Subtitle]: 從眼尾開始稍微把眼皮往上掀 對準睫毛根部黏上去. (12) [Subtitle]: 再用夾子輕壓 讓它跟真睫毛貼合在一起. (13) [Subtitle]: 同樣的動作接著黏中段跟前段. (14) [Subtitle]: 你們看是不是馬上放大 但效果又很自然. (15) [Subtitle]: 對新手來說 勢必要多練習幾次才會上手. (16) [Subtitle]: 不過我覺得上手之後 真的滿省時間的. (17) [Subtitle]: 但這種假睫毛就比較不適合 單眼皮或是內雙眼皮比較窄的人. (18) [Subtitle]: 因為就少了空間可以黏睫毛. (19) [Subtitle]: 如果覺得教學很實用 趕快分享給你身邊 喜歡睫毛又長又翹的朋友吧.
